_comment: Day cycle + procedural weather tuning (UE-only; docs/systems/environment-weather.md, Data/EnvironmentTuning, struct FEnvironmentConfig). Unreal is the master copy. *_hour = game clock hours (0..24); *_real_seconds and weather_transition_seconds = REAL seconds; weather_dwell_phase_fraction = share of the real duration of the phase a weather state started in; start_weight_* = relative weights of the random start weather; *_step_up_chance = 0..1 chance to step UP the ladder (else down). A missing key keeps the code default. Console: CodexTactics.DumpEnvironment.
